text: dsh-tech-splash 是面向 DSH Web 界面的黑白科幻启动屏插件，通过 bundle 将浏览器端启动画面注册到 shell.overlay，并在启动序列完成后等待用户点击或按 Enter 进入程序。它呈现鲸鱼标志、HUD 动效、进度与启动日志，使用 Web Audio 合成提示音，提供静音开关，并随 DSH 主题切换亮暗配色。适合希望为 DSH 页面增加定制启动体验的用户；代码未配置外部服务或 API 密钥。

dsh-tech-splash adds a monochrome startup screen to the DSH web UI. Its browser overlay plays a boot sequence, then waits for a click or Enter. It includes HUD animation, synthesized sound with a mute toggle, and light and dark theme support. The code declares no external service or API key.
想给 DSH 网页版加一个有动画的启动画面。
希望打开 DSH 后先显示启动序列，准备好再进入主界面。
Add a custom animated boot splash to the DSH web interface.
dsh-tech-splash 的功能「启动序列与点击进入」：页面加载时显示进度、日志和 HUD 启动画面；序列完成后，用户点击启动按钮或按 Enter 才进入 DSH。
dsh-tech-splash 的功能「主题与音效控制」：启动屏根据 DSH 当前主题及主题变更事件切换黑白配色；用户可切换提示音，静音状态保存于浏览器 localStorage。

dsh-tech-splash README · 特性：- **纯黑白配色**：暗色是纯黑底 + 白字 + 白鲸，亮色是纯白底 + 黑字 + 墨黑鲸，没有第三种颜色。
- **官方图标**：直接使用 DeepSeek HARNESS 品牌素材里的鲸鱼徽标，与侧边栏 Logo 同源。
- **HUD 启动序列**：旋转刻度环、双向弧段、六边形框、声呐扩散、锁定括号、透视网格、扫描线与两侧数据流。
- **启动日志与遥测**：六行启动日志逐条点亮，右下角深度 / 鳍压 / 气泡 / 链路 / 主题读数。
- **合成科技音效**：低频起航轰声、逐行“滴”声、就绪双音、点击进入时的上行音阶与气流声；全部由 Web Audio 实时合成，**不加载任何音频文件**。
- **点击启动进入程序**：进度跑满后停在「引擎就绪 · 等待启动」，点击任意处、点击「点击启动」或按 <kbd>Enter</kbd> 才真正进入；启动中点击只会快进到就绪。
- **跟随主题**：读取 DSH 当前解析后的主题（系统 / 亮色 / 暗色），并通过 `theme/change` 事件实时同步。
- **可静音**：右上角「音效 开/关」，选择会记住（`localStorage`，键名 `dsh.techSplash.muted`）。
- **零网络请求**：除 DSH 本身的页面加载外，不请求任何外部资源，不上报任何数据。

dsh-tech-splash README · 效果流程：| 阶段 | 画面 | 音效 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 启动 0–2.4s | 环阵点亮、鲸鱼浮现、日志逐行点亮、进度环填充 | 低频起航音 + 每阶段一声“滴” |
| 就绪 | 「引擎就绪 · 等待启动」，中央出现脉冲描边的「点击启动」 | 双音提示 |
| 点击 / Enter | 白光一闪 + 轻微放大 | 气流扫频 + 三音上行 + 低频落点 |
| 结束后 | 淡出，进入 DSH 主界面 | — |

dsh-tech-splash README · 方式二：在「发现」里添加索引源：DSH 0.2.1 起支持自定义插件市场索引（需要启用实验性 bundle「自定义插件市场」）。在 **插件 → 发现 → 索引源** 添加：

```
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/XHSecurity/dsh-tech-splash@main/market/index.json
```

备用地址（网络访问不了 jsDelivr 时）：

```

添加后即可搜索到本插件并直接安装。索引文件遵循 `format: 1` 规范，内容随每次发版由 `npm run market:index` 重新生成。

dsh-tech-splash README · 使用：- 每次页面加载都会播放启动屏（刷新也算一次启动）。
- 启动动画期间点击 → 快进到「就绪」；就绪后点击 → 进入程序。
- 按 <kbd>Enter</kbd> 等同于点击。
- 右上角切换音效；不同浏览器对自动播放有策略限制，首次加载可能听不到启动音，**点击进入那一下一定有声音**。
- 主题随 DSH 设置（系统 / 亮色 / 暗色）自动切换，无需重启。

dsh-tech-splash README · 兼容性：- DSH：`>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0`（在 0.2.1-rc.3 上开发与验证）。
- 平台：DSH Web / 桌面端（Electron）内的 Web UI；仅使用 `shell.overlay`、`locale`、`theme` 三个稳定扩展点。
- 无依赖、无构建步骤、无 host 半侧逻辑。

如果 DSH 升级后出现不兼容，可在 `package.json` 的 `engines.dsh` 与 `dsh.compatibility.dshReleases` 中调整，并同步更新插件市场索引（`npm run market:index`）。

dsh-tech-splash README · 自定义：| 想改什么 | 位置 |
| --- | --- |
| 启动时长 | `client.js` 顶部 `BOOT_MS`（默认 2400ms） |
| 启动日志 / 标题 / 提示文案 | `client.js` 里的 `ZH` / `EN` 字典 |
| 音效音量 | `createSound()` 中的 `master.gain.value` 与各 cue 的 `gain` |
| 音效音高 | `createSound()` 中 `stage()` / `ready()` / `enter()` 的频率 |
| 黑白配色 | `client.js` 里 `.tfs-root` 与 `.tfs-root.is-light` 的 `--tfs-*` 变量 |
| 徽标尺寸 | `client.js` 中 `WHALE_SCALE` |
| 插件页标题 / 描述 | `locale/zh.json`、`locale/en.json` 的 `meta` |

改完执行 `npm run check`，刷新页面即可看到效果。

dsh-tech-splash README · 已知限制：- 浏览器自动播放策略可能让启动阶段的音效静音，直到用户第一次交互；这是浏览器行为，不是插件缺陷。
- 启动屏按“每次页面加载”播放，没有“只播一次 / 跳过下次”的持久开关；如果以后需要可以加。
- 音效由 Web Audio 合成，音色偏电子、轻量，不是真实音源采样。

dsh-tech-splash README · Introduction：

A monochrome sci-fi startup screen for DeepSeek Harness: the official whale mark, a HUD boot sequence, synthesized sound cues, and click-to-enter.

English | 简体中文

---

dsh-tech-splash README · Features：- **Pure black and white** — dark is black with white type and a white whale; light is white with black type and an ink whale. No third color.
- **Official mark** — the DeepSeek HARNESS whale from the app's own brand artwork, the same glyph as the sidebar logo.
- **HUD boot sequence** — rotating tick rings, counter-rotating arcs, hex frame, sonar pings, targeting brackets, perspective grid, scanlines and data streams.
- **Boot log and telemetry** — six log lines light up in order, with depth / fins / bubbles / link / theme readouts.
- **Synthesized sound cues** — a low launch swell, a blip per log line, a two-note ready chime, and a rising arpeggio plus air sweep when you enter. All generated with Web Audio; **no audio files are loaded**.
- **Click to enter** — when the progress completes, the splash holds at "engine ready · awaiting launch". Click anywhere, click the button, or press <kbd>Enter</kbd> to enter; clicking during boot only fast-forwards to ready.
- **Theme aware** — reads the resolved DSH theme (system / light / dark) and follows `theme/change` live.
- **Mute toggle** — top-right "SFX ON/OFF", persisted in `localStorage` under `dsh.te

dsh-tech-splash README · Flow：| Stage | Screen | Sound |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Boot 0–2.4 s | rings light up, whale appears, log lines light, progress arc fills | launch swell + one blip per stage |
| Ready | "engine ready · awaiting launch", pulsing "CLICK TO START" | two-note chime |
| Click / Enter | white flash + slight zoom | air sweep + rising arpeggio + low hit |
| After | fades out to DSH | — |

dsh-tech-splash README · 1. Plugin market (recommended)：Once listed on [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin), search **"DeepSeek HARNESS Boot Splash"** in dshmarket or the DSH **Plugins** page and install with one click.

dsh-tech-splash README · 2. Add the index source：DSH 0.2.1+ can read custom market indexes (enable the experimental "Custom plugin markets" bundle). In **Plugins → Discover → Index sources**, add:

```
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/XHSecurity/dsh-tech-splash@main/market/index.json
```

Fallback:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XHSecurity/dsh-tech-splash/main/market/index.json
```

The file is a `format: 1` index regenerated on every release by `npm run market:index`.

dsh-tech-splash README · 3. Install by package name：In **Plugins → Add plugin**, or with the CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-tech-splash
```

You can also paste the repository URL: `https://github.com/XHSecurity/dsh-tech-splash`.

dsh-tech-splash README · 4. Local development：Clone the repository and install it from a local directory (the plugin manager dialog, or an agent calling `plugin_manager install_bundle`). Development installs are symlinks, so edits apply on refresh.

dsh-tech-splash README · Usage：- The splash plays on every page load (a refresh counts as a launch).
- Click during boot to fast-forward to ready; click once ready to enter.
- <kbd>Enter</kbd> behaves like a click.
- Toggle sound at the top-right. Browser autoplay policies may silence the boot cues until the first interaction; the click-to-enter sound always plays.
- Theme follows DSH settings (system / light / dark) without a restart.

dsh-tech-splash README · Compatibility：- DSH: `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0` (developed and verified on 0.2.1-rc.3).
- Platform: the DSH Web UI inside the desktop app or a browser; uses only the stable `shell.overlay`, `locale`, and `theme` extension points.
- No dependencies, no build step, no host-side logic.

If a DSH upgrade breaks it, adjust `engines.dsh` and `dsh.compatibility.dshReleases` in `package.json`, then regenerate the market index.

dsh-tech-splash README · Customize：| What | Where |
| --- | --- |
| Duration | `BOOT_MS` in `client.js` (default 2400 ms) |
| Log / title / hint copy | `ZH` and `EN` dictionaries in `client.js` |
| Sound level | `master.gain.value` and per-cue `gain` in `createSound()` |
| Sound pitch | frequencies in `stage()` / `ready()` / `enter()` |
| Black-and-white palette | `--tfs-*` variables on `.tfs-root` and `.tfs-root.is-light` |
| Mark size | `WHALE_SCALE` in `client.js` |
| Plugin card text | `locale/zh.json`, `locale/en.json` `meta` |
dsh-tech-splash README · Customize：Run `npm run check` after editing.

The full release flow (npm publish, GitHub Release, awesome-dsh-plugin submission, index update) is in **[docs/PUBLISHING.md](docs/PUBLISHING.md)**.

dsh-tech-splash README · Limitations：- Autoplay policies may silence boot cues until the first interaction.
- The splash plays on every page load; there is no persisted "skip next time" switch.
- Cues are synthesized, so they are electronic and light rather than sampled.
